steps.title: Establish Project Identity and Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json and verify consistency of the application name PicCraft Photo Editor with package identifier com.piccraftphotoeditor.app.

steps.title: Configure Premium XML Asset - Gold Gradient
steps.description: Create bg_premium_gold.xml containing a luxury golden metallic gradient with subtle rounded corners to style high-end buttons and PRO badges.

steps.title: Configure Premium XML Asset - Dark Panel
steps.description: Create bg_panel_dark.xml to apply a premium obsidian glass-like layout style to controls and filter containers with deep dark shades.

steps.title: Configure Premium XML Asset - Modern Translucent Button
steps.description: Create bg_button_dark.xml utilizing a semi-transparent dark state list drawable with a subtle premium platinum border for normal buttons.

steps.title: Configure Premium XML Asset - Active Navigation Tab Background
steps.description: Create bg_tab_active.xml to render a gold bottom indicator line denoting active sections on the primary premium navigation bar.

steps.title: Revamp Main Activity Layout with Premium Obsidian Theme
steps.description: Overhaul activity_main.xml with advanced layout elements, rounded container boxes, premium Gold action points, new modern vector control options, custom SeekBars, and structural aesthetic optimization.

steps.title: Implement Premium Color Matrices and AI Enhance Pipeline
steps.description: Introduce elite filters like Cyberpunk, Royal Gold, Emerald Dream, and Midnight Mist along with a high-fidelity AI Auto-Enhance image pipeline inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Incorporate Real-time Picture Frame Overlays
steps.description: Develop full canvas rendering routines inside the Custom PhotoEditorView to seamlessly overlay Gold Foil, Cyber Neon, Film Strip, and Cinematic Matte borders on edited images.

steps.title: Refine User Feedback System and Premium Styling State Engines
steps.description: Program custom UI highlight methods to dynamically colorize and scale selected colors, tabs, frame selectors, and filters with sleek state logic.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Review AndroidManifest.xml ensuring standard orientation locks, hardware acceleration, and the correct xmlns:android namespace declaration are intact.

steps.title: Verify Dependency-Free Build System Compatibility
steps.description: Analyze build.gradle to ensure strict alignment with AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and SDK 34 specifications without illegal external dependencies.

steps.title: Building PicCraft Photo Editor
steps.description: Execute the full compilation of the modern premium PicCraft Photo Editor debug APK.
